intendedBase.rule: Verify live state again before branching; do not modify PR #84 directly.

rules: Muted charcoal/bark, dusty sakura, warm cream and restrained aged bronze.
Anime/cel character with tactile stone, leather, cloth and metal.
Small navigation glyphs follow the approved thin line-art icon sheet, not the large feature illustrations.
Large feature art may be ornate where the surface supports it.
Do not use rejected pastel-cartoon icons or earlier rejected inventory-item experiments as authority.
Different games may use different art styles and POVs while retaining Mori identity.

runtimePolicy.reducedMotion: Disable optional drift/parallax while preserving semantics.
